resources.string: READ-ONLY EXPERIMENT: No organizing, moving, copying or deleting. Separate app and private telemetry log. Background signals and readiness evidence are measurements, never authorization to change files.
Allow All Files Access specifically for S26 Read-Only Telemetry. This permission is separate from Build 3.1 and the Build 3.2 diagnostic. Return here to recheck access.
Open Settings → Special app access → All files access, then choose S26 Read-Only Telemetry. Return here to check access again.
